resources.string: Open several files and switch between them here without closing any.
Phone folder ↔ Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Box folder
Connect a cloud account (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or Box) to sync folders
No synced folders. Add a folder from your phone and choose a matching cloud folder.

Sync runs both ways: almost instantly while the app is open, when you save a file, and every 15 minutes in the background. If a file changed in both places, the cloud version is kept as \"(conflicting copy)\" next to yours, so nothing is lost. A deletion on one side is applied to the other unless the file was edited there.
Waiting for the battery to charge
Every 15 minutes and when something changes. \"Sync now\" always works.
